show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Ram Parameswaran - Internet Scale Businesses – [Invest Like the Best, EP.207]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Ram Parameswaran, founder of Octahedron Capital.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Ram Parameswaran, founder of Octahedron Capital. Ram started Octahedron this year after more than 5 years as a partner at Altimeter Capital where he made investments in Square, Bytedance, Pinduoduo, and Udaan. In our conversation we cover the potential for internet scale businesses, explore the common characteristics of these businesses.

key_points.text: In our conversation we cover the potential for internet scale businesses, explore the common characteristics of these businesses.
This conversation was a blast of energy and could have gone on for 2 more hours.
I hope to have Ram on again and can't imagine what his conversations are like at the dinner table with his wife and former podcast guest.
